<style>
.v8{--teal:#2DBFAE;--violet:#9B7EDE;--rose:#E8749A;--emerald:#34D399;--indigo:#818CF8;--magenta:#E879C9}

#segProj .tgb[data-key="classif"][aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--third);border-color:var(--third)}
.v8 .cta{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .sec .h2 i{margin-right:9px}
.v8 .statrow{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.v8 .statbig{font-size:34px;font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.v8 .statlabel{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.v8 .hook{max-width:540px;margin:10px auto 0;padding:0 20px;text-align:center;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.55}
.v8 .projctx{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
.v8 .projctx .orgmini{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:6px;box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.v8 .projctx .orgmini img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.v8 .projctx span{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted)}
.v8 .steps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:34px 20px;max-width:1140px;margin:26px auto 0;padding:0 20px}
.v8 .stepcard{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);animation:v8stepin .35s ease forwards}
@keyframes v8stepin{to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.v8 .stepshape{width:100%;max-width:380px;aspect-ratio:1;padding:2.5px;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:hidden}
.v8 .shp-circle{clip-path:circle(50% at 50% 50%)}
.v8 .shp-pentagon{clip-path:polygon(50% 0%,100% 38%,82% 100%,18% 100%,0% 38%)}
.v8 .shp-hexagon{clip-path:polygon(25% 0%,75% 0%,100% 50%,75% 100%,25% 100%,0% 50%)}
.v8 .shapeinner.shp-circle .steptext{padding:4px 20% 20%}
.v8 .shapeinner.shp-pentagon .steptext{padding:4px 16% 14%}
.v8 .shapeinner.shp-hexagon .steptext{padding:4px 13% 15%}
.v8 .shapeinner{width:100%;height:100%;background:var(--panel);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.v8 .stepheadtop{flex:0 0 27%;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;padding-bottom:6px;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;background:var(--bg)}
.v8 .steptext{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;padding:10px 14% 14%}
.v8 .stepitems{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;text-align:left}
.v8 .stepitems li{position:relative;padding-left:13px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.42;margin-bottom:8px}
.v8 .stepitems li:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.v8 .stepitems li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.5em;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pc,currentColor);opacity:.8}
.v8 .steptext.clamped{cursor:pointer}
.v8 .textfull{position:absolute;top:0;left:50%;width:100%;max-width:320px;transform:translate(-50%,-8px) scale(.96);box-sizing:border-box;text-align:left;background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--pc);border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:0 20px 44px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.5);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .18s ease,transform .18s ease;z-index:40}
.v8 .textfull .capfull{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--pc);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:9px}
.v8 .textfull .stepitems li{font-size:13px;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:9px}
.v8 .stepshape:hover ~ .textfull,.v8 .textfull:hover{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1);pointer-events:auto}
.v8 .steptoggle{--pc:var(--blue);margin-top:18px;width:100%;max-width:230px;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-radius:26px;padding:5px 18px 5px 5px;font-family:inherit;background:var(--panel);border:1.5px solid var(--pc);color:var(--pc);transition:background .22s,color .22s,transform .2s,box-shadow .22s}
.v8 .steptoggle .toggleicon{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pc);color:var(--onblue);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;flex:none;transition:background .22s,color .22s}
.v8 .steptoggle:hover{background:var(--pc);color:var(--onblue);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px -8px var(--pc)}
.v8 .steptoggle:hover .toggleicon{background:var(--onblue);color:var(--pc)}
.v8 .steptoggle:active{transform:translateY(0)}
.v8 .steptoggle i.bi-chevron-down{font-size:9px;transition:transform .25s}
.v8 .steptoggle[aria-expanded="true"] i.bi-chevron-down{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.v8 .stepdetail{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.32,1),opacity .3s ease,transform .3s ease;opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px) scale(.97);text-align:center;width:100%;max-width:420px}
.v8 .stepdetail.open{max-height:1400px;opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);margin-top:16px}
.v8 .stepdetail-inner{--pc:var(--blue);position:relative;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 19px 18px;background:var(--panel);box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.v8 .stepdetail-inner::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;background:var(--pc)}
.v8 .stepdetail p{font-size:13px;color:var(--txt);line-height:1.62;margin:0}
.v8 .stepdetail .bub{justify-content:center;padding:0;margin:0;min-height:0;gap:9px 10px}
.v8 .detailgroup:not(:first-child){margin-top:18px}
.v8 .detailsub{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:9px}
.v8 .detailsub i{font-size:11px}
.v8 .stepdetail .bb{font-size:10.5px;padding:6px 12px;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
.v8 .pubstatus{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;font-weight:700}
.v8 .pubstatus i{margin-right:6px;font-size:12px}
.v8 .stepdetail .bb:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 4px 10px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.v8 .stepdetail .tlinks{margin-top:12px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v8 .stepdetail .tlinks:first-child{margin-top:0}
.v8 .stepdetail .tlinks .btn{margin-top:0;font-size:10.5px;padding:6px 10px;white-space:nowrap}
.v8 .btn-off{opacity:.32;pointer-events:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v8 .stepcard{animation:none;opacity:1;transform:none}}

.v8 .industsection{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:40px;padding:44px 0 0}
.v8 .industsection .sec{padding-top:0}
.v8 .teachsection{background:var(--panel);border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:56px;padding:52px 0 64px}

.v8 .animsection .tabadge{font-size:14px;color:var(--txt);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:6px 13px}

var activeProj="lgd";
var curLang=(window.localStorage && localStorage.getItem("site-lang")) || "fr";

function selectProj(key){
  activeProj=key;
  document.querySelectorAll("#segProj .tgb").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-key")===key);});
  renderProj();
}

function buildProjSeg(){
  segProjWrap.innerHTML="";
  PROJ.forEach(function(p){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="tgb"; b.textContent=p[curLang].short;
    b.setAttribute("data-key",p.key);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", p.key===activeProj);
    b.onclick=function(){selectProj(p.key);};
    segProjWrap.appendChild(b);
  });
}

function renderProj(){
  var p=PROJ.filter(function(x){return x.key===activeProj;})[0];
  var t=p[curLang];
  var phaseLabels=PHASE_LABELS[curLang], toggleMeta=TOGGLE_META[curLang], subLabels=SUB_LABELS[curLang], pubMeta=PUBSTATE_META[curLang];
  statBig.textContent=t.statBig; statBig.style.color=p.col;
  statLabel.textContent=t.statLabel;
  projHook.textContent=t.hook;
  projCtx.innerHTML="<span class='orgmini'><img src='"+p.orgLogo+"' alt=''></span><span>"+t.org+"</span>";

  stepsEl.innerHTML="";
  t.steps.forEach(function(s,i){
    var pc=PHASE_COLORS[i];
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="stepcard";
    card.style.animationDelay=(i*90)+"ms";
    var shp="shp-"+PHASE_SHAPES[i];

    function tagRow(items){
      return "<div class='bub'>"+items.map(function(x){
        return "<div class='bb' style='border-color:"+pc+";color:var(--txt);background:color-mix(in srgb, "+pc+" 14%, transparent)'>"+x+"</div>";
      }).join("")+"</div>";
    }
    function linksRow(items){
      return "<div class='tlinks'>"+items.map(function(it){
        if(it[1]){
          return "<a class='btn' href='"+it[1]+"' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>"+it[0]+" <i class='bi "+it[2]+"'></i></a>";
        }
        return "<span class='btn btn-off' aria-disabled='true'>"+it[0]+" <i class='bi "+it[2]+"'></i></span>";
      }).join("")+"</div>";
    }
    var toggleLabel=toggleMeta[i].label, toggleIcon=toggleMeta[i].icon, detailHtml;
    if(i===0){
      detailHtml=
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-globe-americas'></i>"+subLabels.dataReal+"</span>"+tagRow(t.dataReal)+"</div>";
      if(t.dataSim && t.dataSim.length){
        detailHtml+=
          "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-dice-5-fill'></i>"+subLabels.dataSim+"</span>"+tagRow(t.dataSim)+"</div>";
      }
    } else if(i===1){
      detailHtml=
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-mortarboard-fill'></i>"+subLabels.skills+"</span>"+tagRow(t.skills)+"</div>"+
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-cpu-fill'></i>"+subLabels.tools+"</span>"+tagRow(t.tools)+"</div>";
    } else {
      var stateMeta=pubMeta[p.pubState];
      var statusText = stateMeta.label + (p.pubState==="redaction" ? "" : " · "+p.period);
      var statusPill="<div class='bub'><div class='bb pubstatus' style='border-color:"+pc+";color:var(--txt);background:color-mix(in srgb, "+pc+" 14%, transparent)'><i class='bi "+stateMeta.icon+"'></i>"+statusText+"</div></div>";
      detailHtml=
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-info-circle-fill'></i>"+subLabels.status+"</span>"+statusPill+"</div>"+
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-file-earmark-text'></i>"+subLabels.articles+"</span>"+linksRow([[subLabels.article,p.article,"bi-file-earmark-text"],[subLabels.preprint,p.preprint,"bi-file-earmark-richtext"]])+"</div>"+
        "<div class='detailgroup'><span class='detailsub' style='color:"+pc+"'><i class='bi bi-github'></i>"+subLabels.code+"</span>"+linksRow([[subLabels.code,p.code,"bi-github"]])+"</div>";
    }

    function itemList(items){
      return "<ul class='stepitems'>"+items.map(function(x){return "<li>"+x+"</li>";}).join("")+"</ul>";
    }
    var previewItems=s.items.slice(0,3), hasMore=s.items.length>previewItems.length;

    card.innerHTML=
      "<div class='stepshape "+shp+"' style='background:"+pc+"'>"+
      "<div class='shapeinner "+shp+"'>"+
      "<div class='stepheadtop' style='color:"+pc+"'>"+phaseLabels[i]+"</div>"+
      "<div class='steptext"+(hasMore?" clamped":"")+"' style='--pc:"+pc+"'>"+itemList(previewItems)+"</div></div></div>"+
      "<div class='textfull' style='--pc:"+pc+"'><span class='capfull'>"+phaseLabels[i]+"</span>"+itemList(s.items)+"</div>"+
      "<button type='button' class='steptoggle' aria-expanded='false' style='--pc:"+pc+"'>"+
      "<span class='toggleicon'><i class='bi "+toggleIcon+"'></i></span>"+toggleLabel+" <i class='bi bi-chevron-down'></i></button>"+
      "<div class='stepdetail'><div class='stepdetail-inner' style='--pc:"+pc+"'>"+detailHtml+"</div></div>";
    stepsEl.appendChild(card);

    var toggle=card.querySelector(".steptoggle"), detail=card.querySelector(".stepdetail");
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var open=detail.classList.toggle("open");
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
    });
  });
}

buildProjSeg();
renderProj();

window.addEventListener("sitelangchange", function(e){
  curLang=e.detail.lang;
  buildProjSeg();
  renderProj();
});
})();

var CPHASE_SHAPES=["square","octagon"];
var CPHASE_COLORS=["var(--emerald)","var(--indigo)"];
var CPHASE_LABELS={fr:["Programme","Compétences & outils"], en:["Curriculum","Skills & tools"]};
var TOOLS_PREFIX={fr:"Outils : ", en:"Tools: "};
var segWrap=document.getElementById("segCourse"),
    courseStepsEl=document.getElementById("courseSteps"), courseCtx=document.getElementById("courseCtx");
var activeCourse="lineaire";
var curLang2=(window.localStorage && localStorage.getItem("site-lang")) || "fr";

function buildSeg(){
  segWrap.innerHTML="";
  COURSES.forEach(function(c){
    var b=document.createElement("button"); b.className="tgb"; b.textContent=curLang2==="en" ? c.labelEn : c.label;
    b.setAttribute("data-key", c.key);
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", c.key===activeCourse);
    b.onclick=function(){selectCourse(c.key);};
    segWrap.appendChild(b);
  });
}

function selectCourse(key){
  activeCourse=key;
  document.querySelectorAll("#segCourse .tgb").forEach(function(b){b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", b.getAttribute("data-key")===key);});
  renderCourse();
}

function renderCourse(){
  var c=COURSES.filter(function(x){return x.key===activeCourse;})[0];
  var t=c[curLang2];
  var phaseLabels=CPHASE_LABELS[curLang2];
  courseCtx.innerHTML="<span class='orgmini' style='background:transparent;box-shadow:none'><i class='bi bi-mortarboard-fill' style='font-size:20px;color:var(--txt)'></i></span><span>"+t.public+" · "+t.format+"</span>";

  courseStepsEl.innerHTML="";
  var competencesFull=t.competences.slice();
  if(c.outils && c.outils.length){ competencesFull.push(TOOLS_PREFIX[curLang2]+c.outils.join(", ")); }
  var facets=[t.programme, competencesFull];
  facets.forEach(function(items,i){
    var pc=CPHASE_COLORS[i];
    var card=document.createElement("div"); card.className="stepcard";
    card.style.animationDelay=(i*90)+"ms";
    var shp="shp-"+CPHASE_SHAPES[i];

    function itemList(arr){
      return "<ul class='stepitems'>"+arr.map(function(x){return "<li>"+x+"</li>";}).join("")+"</ul>";
    }
    var previewItems=items.slice(0,3), hasMore=items.length>previewItems.length;

    card.innerHTML=
      "<div class='stepshape "+shp+"' style='background:"+pc+"'>"+
      "<div class='shapeinner "+shp+"'>"+
      "<div class='stepheadtop' style='color:"+pc+"'>"+phaseLabels[i]+"</div>"+
      "<div class='steptext"+(hasMore?" clamped":"")+"' style='--pc:"+pc+"'>"+itemList(previewItems)+"</div></div></div>"+
      "<div class='textfull' style='--pc:"+pc+"'><span class='capfull'>"+phaseLabels[i]+"</span>"+itemList(items)+"</div>";
    courseStepsEl.appendChild(card);
  });
}

buildSeg();
renderCourse();

window.addEventListener("sitelangchange", function(e){
  curLang2=e.detail.lang;
  buildSeg();
  renderCourse();
});
})();
</script>
